marking_points.criterion: Both dates correctly filtered with AND.

partial_credit_notes: Award independent criteria up to the stated total; accept equivalent technically correct wording/solutions.

verification.technical: SQLite query executed on matching and nonmatching loans.
verification.test_code:
import sqlite3
c=sqlite3.connect(':memory:');c.executescript("CREATE TABLE Member(MemberID,Surname);CREATE TABLE Loan(LoanID,MemberID,DateOut,DateRet);INSERT INTO Member VALUES(1,'Ng'),(2,'Patel');INSERT INTO Loan VALUES(1,1,'2027-03-01','2027-03-05'),(2,2,'2027-03-02','2027-03-05');")
assert c.execute("SELECT m.Surname FROM Member m JOIN Loan l ON m.MemberID=l.MemberID WHERE l.DateOut='2027-03-01' AND l.DateRet='2027-03-05'").fetchall()==[('Ng',)]
